name: Megakernels
configuration: thinker decode steps on one kernel launch of 64 CTAs, its 2–64-token prompt chunks on a prefill kernel of 128 CTAs (VLLM_OMNI_THINKER_MEGAKERNEL=1, VLLM_OMNI_THINKER_MEGAKERNEL_CTAS=64, VLLM_OMNI_THINKER_MEGAKERNEL_PREFILL=1, VLLM_OMNI_THINKER_MEGAKERNEL_PREFILL_CTAS=128)
talker decode steps on the talker kernel (VLLM_OMNI_TALKER_MEGAKERNEL=1)
every code-predictor call on one kernel launch of 96 CTAs (VLLM_OMNI_CODE_PREDICTOR_MEGAKERNEL=1, VLLM_OMNI_CODE_PREDICTOR_MEGAKERNEL_CTAS=96)
VLLM_OMNI_DETERMINISTIC_MARLIN=1 is set but idle: the thinker runs on triton, keeping the checkpoint's packing for its kernels
code2wav on CUDA graphs captured only at streaming sizes, its one-frame first chunk on torch.compile (VLLM_OMNI_CODE2WAV_STREAM_GRAPHS=1, VLLM_OMNI_CODE2WAV_COMPILE=1)
frame 0 ships with the talker's prefill step, is decoded on code2wav's weights and sent straight to the API (VLLM_OMNI_FRAME0=1, VLLM_OMNI_FRAME0_AUDIO=1)

the talker gets its prefill input at the thinker's first token, built without host syncs, and prefills all but its last position while the thinker prefills (VLLM_OMNI_EARLY_CHUNK=1, VLLM_OMNI_TALKER_PREP=1, VLLM_OMNI_TALKER_PREPREFILL=1)
the thinker waits while the talker makes frame 0; a stage wakes when an upstream chunk lands instead of on a 1 ms poll (VLLM_OMNI_THINKER_YIELD=1, VLLM_OMNI_FAST_POLL=1)
the three stages share the GPU under CUDA MPS
